goal: Produce one tiny reference note for a placeholder movement toy that can inform Art Agent placeholder styling and Implementation Agent movement-tuning context without selecting a final game concept.
forbidden_changes: Godot project, scene, script, build, or smoke-test edits
market report, audience report, store analysis, or opportunity-space acceptance
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Research note remains narrow
verify.description: Confirm the note contains only a tiny placeholder movement-toy reference: research question, 2-4 reference observations, movement-facing implication, uncertainty or source/rationale notes, and handoff summary.

verify.name: No final concept or market report claim is made
verify.description: Confirm the note does not choose a final game concept, accept an opportunity space, promote learning cards, or expand into market, audience, store, or positioning analysis.

verify.name: Only authorized research artifacts changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- | grep -Ev "^(research_notes/RN-2026W22-001-placeholder-movement-toy.md|runs/RUN-20260528-002.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-003.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

acceptance_criteria: The Work Package authorizes exactly one tiny research note and one Research Run record.
The research note gives Art Agent and Implementation Agent usable movement-toy reference context without requiring either agent to re-research the same question.
The note states source links or explicit rationale, and marks uncertainty instead of overstating evidence.
The note does not select a final game concept, modify Godot files, produce a market report, or promote any Learning Card beyond Candidate authority.
The handoff targets are limited to Art Agent, Implementation Agent, and Learning Librarian Agent as allowed by agents/HANDOFF_MAP.md.
notes: This Work Package closes only the next missing Research Agent handoff gap from the Phase 1 tiny dry-run closeout. If the research implies a concept, audience, or opportunity-space decision, stop and request Human Creative Owner judgment instead of deciding inside this package.
